config system interface
    edit "fortilink"
        set fortilink enable
        set type aggregate
    next
    edit "_default"
        set switch-controller-feature default-vlan
        set interface "fortilink"
        set vlanid 1
    next
    edit "quarantine"
        set switch-controller-feature quarantine
        set interface "fortilink"
        set vlanid 4093
    next
    edit "host01"
        set interface "fortilink"
        set vlanid 100
    next
    edit "host02"
        set interface "fortilink"
        set vlanid 211
    next
end
